=== SIM.BATCH Cohort branching target ===
 Initial planning up to 100 unique baseline patients, five branches each, four dated states; not independent real patients. 
Sources: SIM,DATA

=== AI.TEMP Temporal analysis ===
 State history, trends and baselines, irregular intervals and known input scope. 
Sources: AI,SAF
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.AI Multimodal intelligence

=== AI.FORECAST Optional future-state forecasts ===
 Only with qualified independent real-data evaluation; abstain otherwise. Synthetic simulator is not predictive validation. 
Sources: AI,SAF
